title: Mulberrycoloured
html_source: This calls back to Stephen’s reference to Shakespeare’s mulberry trees at Stratford-on-Avon.

anchor.prefix:
mirthfully he told the shadows, souls of men:

 — The most innocent son of Erin, Stephen said, for whom they ever lifted them.
